profile.name: Josiah Steve Sam
profile.intro: I build production web platforms, backend services and AI applications: RAG, agentic workflows and document OCR, across SaaS, banking, travel and EdTech.
notes: Software Engineer (AI) at Credentech Solutions in Chennai since April 2026. I own architecture decisions across retrieval, inference and multi-tenant trade-offs, lead client-facing technical scoping, and mentor an incoming engineer on RAG pipeline design and production debugging.
Before that, as a Junior Software Engineer there, I delivered 4 client projects across banking, SaaS, food and beverage, and travel, covering frontend, backend, AI services and deployment.
I studied for an Integrated M.Sc. in Computational Statistics and Data Analytics at Vellore Institute of Technology, and started in industry as a data science intern at Quelit.
